title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E24 — Rated X
Fred, Lamont and Rollo almost become stars in an X-rated movie until they are faced with the 'naked' truth and the wrath of Esther.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E1 — Crossed Swords
Lamont discovers that the porcelain figure he has bought is worth a great deal of money and decides auctioning off the piece will bring the best price. Fred's actions as a shill backfire, shattering Lamont's chance for freedom...and the statue.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E2 — Happy Birthday, Pop
Fred's 65th birthday is anything but happy when his first Social Security check and Lamont's 'night on the town' don't meet his expectations.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E3 — Here Comes The Bride There Goes The Bride
Fred's protest against Lamont's impending marriage fails to change his son's mind. But as the ceremony begins, the bride-to-be changes her mind, leaving Lamont standing at the altar and haggling with his relatives over their wedding gifts.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E4 — The Copper Caper
Fred's suspicions about a used-copper salesman are ignored by Lamont, especially after his son checks the metal's going price. But unfortunately for everyone, Fred's instincts prove to be correct. The copper Lamont bought was stolen.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E5 — A Matter Of Life And Breath
Lamont and Fred, at Lamont's insistence, take advantage of the free tests offered by a Breathmobile. The results convince Fred that he has tuberculosis.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E5 — George's Dream
Obsessed with landing a crucial new cleaning account, an overwrought and exhausted George lapses into sleep and wakes up to a terrifying look at his future.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E6 — George's New Stockbroker
George is fascinated by a highly successful -- if unconventional -- stockbroker, until he finds out about his unusual medical past.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E7 — Me And Billy Dee
Billy Dee Williams makes a guest appearance in the Jefferson living room, but can't convince his 'number one fan' Florence that he is who he is.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E8 — Half A Brother
George's attempts to make points with a local banker are frustrated by Allan's attempts to make points with the banker's daughter.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E9 — What Are Friends For?
George agonizes over a decision that could change both his life and the life of someone very special. George's favorite cousin, Dusty, delights the Jeffersons with a surprise visit, but concerns them with some serious news.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E10 — George Who?
Louise insists that she and George have fallen into a rut, until a turn of fate transforms their 'routine' into the good old days.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E11 — Harry's House Guest
Harry Bentley is stuck with an insufferable lady houseguest and when George Jefferson volunteers to get him unstuck, he winds up sticking Bentley with something worse.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E2 — Bobby Darin, Denise Nicholas, Stanley Myron Handelman, Roy Clark
Flip & Stanley each do monologues; the cast does a taxi skit and a western parody Butch Cassidy & The Suntan Kid.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E3 — Lily Tomlin, Redd Foxx, The Temptations
Lily & Flip do saloon and computer dating bits; Redd gives an English lesson and Rev. Leroy preaches with the Temptations.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E6 — Charlie Callas, Laura Greene, Pat Morita, Louis Armstrong
Callas is a palace guard and Italian cafe patron; Louis leads Rev. Leroy’s church in 'When The Saints Go Marching In.'.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E10 — Bobby Darin, Charley Pride, Ella Fitzgerald
Cast sings 'Who?' with George Wyle on piano; Darin’s a rabid football fan, then the devil battling Rev. Leroy.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E21 — In A New Way
Entertainment is provided by The Spinners and the Jimmy Castor Bunch.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E22 — Wherever We May Be
Stokely Carmichael, the revolutionary leader who created and promulgated the now historic cry of "Black Power.

George and Katherine buy a hot tub that leaks so badly that it destroys the second floor bathroom.

title: Webster

George investigates why he was suddenly dropped as an endorsed candidate for the Board of Education.

title: Webster

title: Webster
description:
S6 E2 — The Painting
At an art gallery, George glimpses at a truly shocking work of art: a nude portrait of Katherine in her younger days.

title: Webster
description:

Webster and his classmates face some unfair competition when they're contestants on a TV quiz show.

Tia gets cold feet after agreeing to take an exam for her twin sister.

title: Sister, Sister
description:

It's a game of musical dates as the girls' family and friends switch partners for a night on the town.

title: Sister, Sister
description:

Tia and Tamera battle it out on behalf of their guys as competition gets tight for a spot in their school's 12 Most Gorgeous Men on Campus calendar.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E14 — Sweet Talk
Tamera lands a job as a radio talk show hostess dispensing advice on love on romance, including her own sister Tia's -- but without Tia's permission!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E15 — Father's Day
The twins think a photojournalist visiting campus may be their biological father.
